title: rwb-decision login, migration file and sequence, constraint and index names, standard-column Field IDs, the dictionary handover and the platform-contract carriage are not fixed by any source
source: TSD P7 Decision center and log v2 T2, T3.0 and T3.1; LDM and Data Dictionary v8 fields sheet; Template and Rules v1 R7.1, R7.3 and R9; R5 default rulings; the WP story line for RWB-P7-E1001-APP
description: Six values this slice has to state are absent from every source: the name of the per-service login of rwb-decision; the file name and the sequence number of the migration; the names of the constraints and the indexes and the column order beyond the leading column of each read path; the Field IDs of the 7 standard columns of TSD P7 T3.0; the way this story's field rows reach the one dictionary of rwb_source_data; and how the six platform contracts of the DP table are carried when the metadata H row is None and Ready to start is Day 1.
evidence: TSD P7 T3.0 lists the 7 standard columns with no Field ID; TSD P7 T3.1 and the LDM fields sheet name no constraint and no index; no source names the rwb-decision login or the migration file, and D-RCV-28 fixes the naming rule only; DP table rows RWB-PLT-E1027-CON, RWB-PLT-E1042-CON, RWB-PLT-E1043-CON, RWB-PLT-E1044-CON, RWB-PLT-E1047-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON add H dependencies that the metadata row of a secondary slice does not carry; no source fixes the panel ids of SCR-10, SCR-11 and SCR-38.
area: Schema, migration, data dictionary and dependency carriage, P7 rwb-decision
owner_role: Solution architect, P7 rwb-decision, with the ACE DB team and the data steward
proposed: Build against the service baseline and its fakes; name the login in the text as the rwb-decision login (DP-02); fix the migration file and its sequence at merge under D-RCV-28; follow the platform naming convention for the constraints and the indexes with the read paths of section 13 as the leading columns; hand the field-row declaration to RWB-P1-E1001-APP as a build artefact proved by the conformance test; and carry the six platform contracts in the preconditions and in these rows instead of an H row.

title: The LDM states one field count for rule_row and a rule_test_case column its fields sheet does not define, and both TSD P7 and the LDM name cross-schema foreign keys that DP-01 forbids
source: Recovery Workbench Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary v8 (entity sheet, fields sheet and relationships sheet); TSD P7 Decision center and log v2 T3.1 and T3.3; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-01
description: The same document disagrees with itself on two points of this slice: its entity sheet states 18 fields for rule_row while its fields sheet lists 21 (DF-REF-001 to DF-REF-015, DF-REF-052 to DF-REF-054 and DF-REF-296 to DF-REF-298), and its relationships sheet names rule_test_case.package_version_id, which its fields sheet does not define. Separately, TSD P7 T3.3 and the relationships sheet declare approval.case_id as a foreign key to recovery_case and approval.delegation_limit_id as a foreign key to delegation_limit, whose owners are rwb_case (P3) and rwb_access (P4) in the target, so DP-01 forbids both keys.
evidence: LDM v8 entity sheet row rule_row states 18; its fields sheet lists the 21 rows above; its relationships sheet carries rule_test_case package_version_id but the fields sheet of rule_test_case stops at DF-REF-197; TSD P7 T3.3 rows: approval case_id to recovery_case, approval delegation_limit_id to delegation_limit; DP-01 forbids a cross-schema read and a cross-schema key.
area: Data model and schema boundary, P7 rwb-decision
owner_role: Solution architect, P7 rwb-decision, with the data owners of rwb_case and rwb_access
proposed: The technical specification outranks the entity sheet on the column set and DP-01 outranks a cross-schema key: build rule_row with the 21 fields its fields sheet lists, create no rule_test_case.package_version_id, keep approval.case_id and approval.delegation_limit_id as values with no foreign key, and keep the five foreign keys of the schema inside rwb_decision; correct the LDM entity sheet, the relationships sheet and TSD P7 T3.3 in their next versions.
